description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for the Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA Linux driver, including PCIe endpoint private data, MSI mode enumeration, and related functions.

methods.name: to_aca
methods.description: Converts a dc_ep_priv pointer to a dc_aca pointer.

methods.name: dc_aca_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ACA for the given endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_info_init
methods.description: Initializes ACA info for the endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Starts the ACA with specified function and start flag.

methods.name: dc_aca_init
methods.description: Initializes the ACA with given parameters.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Gets UMT message address based on endian and type.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_hd_cnt
methods.description: Returns the count of TX input HD.

methods.name: dc_aca_free_fw_file
methods.description: Frees the firmware file associated with the endpoint.
